events.title: WAX ON WAX OFF
events.description:
TV LOUNGE PRESENTS: WAX ON. WAX OFF.

Three selectors. All vinyl. No shortcuts. Just deep grooves, impeccable taste, and the art of working a room one record at a time.

We're kicking off a brand-new TV Lounge party theme dedicated to the ones who know that the magic is in the wax. Three incredible selectors, three distinct musical journeys, and one dancefloor ready to receive.

EDDIE LOGIX A true Detroit musical polymath. Producer, beatmaker, MC, collaborator, and DJ with a deep-rooted understanding of the sounds that shaped the city and the ones that keep pushing it forward. From soulful house and Detroit rhythms to Chicago flavor, forgotten gems, and unexpected gems yet to be discovered, Eddie brings curiosity, creativity, and serious musical instincts to every set. He doesn't just play records. He connects dots.

TURTLE BUGG aka TREEZY B A selector with roots in the African Diaspora and a passport stamped by the sounds of New Jersey, New York, and Detroit. Raised on funk, jazz, hip-hop, and the rich musical traditions of Black culture, Turtle Bugg brings an uncompromising approach to the decks. His philosophy? "This thang formerly known as house." A true digger with an ear beyond trends, he knows the difference between playing what's cool and playing what's timeless.

AMEERA A living archive of sound, guided by soul, rhythm, and the rich lineage of Detroit's musical DNA. Ameera's selections move across genres and generations, weaving nostalgic frequencies with fresh perspectives. Every set unfolds with intention, warmth, and feeling. For Ameera, music is more than a soundtrack. It's memory, reflection, connection, and care translated through vinyl.

Three incredible selectors. Three unique perspectives. One common language: the vinyl record.

Assemble your crew and bring your good vibes. Come ready to dig deep, move freely, and let the music do what it does best.

WAX ON. WAX OFF.

This is TV!

events.title: DJ Amir
events.description:
All the way from Berlin, we have the honor of hosting the legendary DJ Amir for the first time at Tigris!

More than a selector, DJ Amir is a historian, archivist and one of the key voices connecting jazz, soul, hip-hop and deep record culture over the last three decades. Known worldwide as one half of the legendary Kon & Amir partnership, he helped redefine the language of crate digging through the seminal Off Track series on BBE Music. Through his label 180-Proof Records, Amir has been instrumental in restoring and preserving the Strata Records catalogue, bringing one of America's most important independent jazz archives back into circulation. From the early Fat Beats era to Worldwide FM broadcasts and appearances alongside names like Q-Tip and Cut Chemist, Amir's sets move through spiritual jazz, rare groove, soul and leftfield dance music with the depth of someone who genuinely lived the culture.

Sound room opens 5pm // DJ set 9pm // Free before 9pm, $10 after

events.title: small talk
events.description:
thursday, november 19

we're excited to welcome dj sphinx and clairvoyant agside resident britty.

dj sphinx is a detroit-based dj & multimedia artist whose work bridges the city's legendary techno lineage with her own symbolic and narrative-driven practice. she has quickly taken the scene by storm, playing notable events such as tec-troit, movement music festival, the great beyond, and return to the source, among many others. her style draws inspiration from themes of mythology, history, intimacy, and expanded consciousness—inviting listeners into spaces of transformation through frequency & movement. in her sets, dj sphinx threads layered percussion, playful acid grooves, & detroit techno's driving pulse into hypnotic, evolving journeys that are as introspective as they are dance-floor focused.

clairvoyant, a detroit transplant from southern california, has shaped her musical taste through soulful roots and the mechanical pith of the motor city's electronic heritage. music has always been her refuge, but spending nearly a decade in detroit has transformed it into a tangible source of comfort. raised on a diverse range of psychedelic funk and alt-punk, she seamlessly blends these influences into an eclectic mix of deep house and minimal techno. clairvoyant's mixes are characterized by moody synths, dramatic drums, and impactful vocals.

events.title: TOP2BTTM 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
events.description:
ONE WHOLE YEAR OF TOP2BTTM!

25+ shows, over $3000 raised for the local community, and an ever growing roster of incredible queer talent, TOP2BTTM has grown into a home for club music, ass shaking, and a new kind of space for queer connection in Detroit. 

To celebrate this anniversary we are keeping it in the family.

Our wonderful residents M00N-PI + Sina have become an integral part of our operations, and have both grown into their sound so much over the year, bringing two very different perspectives on dance music into a homogenized queer club experience. 

TOP2BTTM also would not be the success it is without jamea. From admin work to bookings, she has stepped up and filled many roles this year, allowing for the T2B experience to elevate and flourish thanks to her adaptability and prowess. She will be joined on the decks for an epic b2b by returning favorite TONIC! 

and finally we have our HBIC, the curator and founder of TOP2BTTM - WE1SMAN - will be present in full f*gg*t form, with a set full of ass shaking debauchery. 

WE WILL BE COLLECTING CANNED GOODS + NON PERISHABLE FOOD ITEMS TO DONATE TO THE RUTH ELLIS CENTER!!

Join Deeper Waters for a very special edition of No Facade as we celebrate the birthday of one of our own, resident DJ and Deeper Waters' other half, Brandon Redoute!

And what better way to celebrate than bringing a little more family into the mix? We're welcoming Detroit techno legend and longtime friend Mike "Agent X" Clark to join us behind the decks for the occasion.

It's Friday the 13th, but there's nothing unlucky about this gathering. Just good people, good music, and another night of doing what we do best.

No Facade. Just a real good time.
